description_en: Queries the configurations of the Intelligent Protection policy for non-website services
description_zh: 查询非网站业务AI智能防护的配置信息
name: DescribePortAutoCcStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

PortAutoCcStatus.description_en: An array that consists of the configurations of the Intelligent Protection policy
PortAutoCcStatus.description_zh: 非网站业务AI智能防护的配置信息

Mode.description_en:
The mode of the Intelligent Protection policy. Valid values:

normal
loose
strict
Mode.description_zh:
AI智能防护的模式。取值：
normal：正常
loose：宽松
strict：严格

Switch.description_en:
The status of the Intelligent Protection policy. Valid values:

on: enabled
off: disabled
Switch.description_zh:
AI智能防护的开关状态。取值：
on：开启
off：关闭

WebMode.description_en:
The protection mode for ports 80 and 443. Valid values:

normal
loose
strict
WebMode.description_zh:
80和443端口的防护模式。取值：
normal：正常
loose：宽松
strict：严格

WebSwitch.description_en:
The status of the Intelligent Protection policy for ports 80 and 443. Valid values:

on: enabled
off: disabled
WebSwitch.description_zh:
80和443端口的防护开关状态。取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
